points.description: States that the drought is linked to a reduction/depletion in water availability, specifically a fall in ground water level (as in the model answer).
points.partial_credit: Half or full if it mentions reduced water/lack of water or low rainfall without ground water level.

points.description: States the usual cause/setting: low rainfall area combined with excessive use of ground water.
points.partial_credit: Half if only one of low rainfall or excessive ground water use is given.

rubric.notes: Full marks for an answer that says the drought involves a big drop in ground water, and that it happens where rainfall is low and ground water is overused, in any wording. Give part marks for a vague or incomplete answer, such as only low rainfall or only less water. Give 0 for unrelated answers. Ignore minor extra remarks unless they contradict the main idea.
